description: This header defines interfaces and types for WebTransport protocol abstraction, including stream and session management, datagram handling, and event notification classes.

classes.name: StreamVisitor
classes.description: Interface for objects notified about WebTransport stream events.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport stream, either bidirectional or unidirectional.

classes.name: SessionVisitor
classes.description: Interface for objects notified about WebTransport session events.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Abstract interface for a WebTransport session, managing streams and datagrams.

methods.name: OnCanRead
methods.description: Called when stream has readable data.

methods.name: OnResetStreamReceived
methods.description: Called when RESET_STREAM is received for the stream.

methods.name: OnStopSendingReceived
methods.description: Called when STOP_SENDING is received for the stream.

methods.name: OnWriteSideInDataRecvdState
methods.description: Called when the write side of the stream is closed and data is acknowledged.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer or string.

methods.name: ReadableBytes
methods.description: Returns number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: GetStreamId
methods.description: Returns the unique stream ID.

methods.name: ResetWithUserCode
methods.description: Resets the stream with a specific error code.

methods.name: SendStopSending
methods.description: Sends a stop-sending signal with an error code.

methods.name: ResetDueToInternalError
methods.description: Resets the stream due to internal error.

methods.name: MaybeResetDueToStreamObjectGone
methods.description: Resets the stream if the object has been garbage collected.

methods.name: visitor
methods.description: Returns the stream's visitor.

methods.name: SetVisitor
methods.description: Sets the stream's visitor.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes the WebTransport session with an error code and message.

methods.name: AcceptIncomingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Returns the earliest incoming bidirectional stream.

methods.name: AcceptIncomingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Returns the earliest incoming unidirectional stream.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Checks if a new outgoing bidirectional stream can be opened.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Checks if a new outgoing unidirectional stream can be opened.

methods.name: OpenOutgoingBidirectionalStream
methods.description: Opens a new outgoing bidirectional stream.

methods.name: OpenOutgoingUnidirectionalStream
methods.description: Opens a new outgoing unidirectional stream.

methods.name: GetStreamById
methods.description: Retrieves a stream by its ID.

methods.name: SendOrQueueDatagram
methods.description: Sends or queues a datagram.

methods.name: GetMaxDatagramSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum datagram size.

methods.name: SetDatagramMaxTimeInQueue
methods.description: Sets the max time a datagram can stay in queue.
